assertions.claim: Sibutramine is the most commonly detected illegal additive in such products — conveyed in RU.
assertions.cn_span: 这类产品里最常查出的违法添加成分是西布曲明

assertions.claim: SCOUT: near-10,000 subjects, mean 3+ years; non-fatal MI ~30% higher, non-fatal stroke ~36% higher on sibutramine — conveyed in RU.
assertions.cn_span: 一项近万人、平均吃三年多的试验里，吃药的人非致死性心梗高约三成，非致死性中风高约三成六

assertions.claim: Only 1.7 kg extra weight loss over 3+ years — conveyed in RU.
assertions.cn_span: 而三年多只多减了 1.7 公斤

assertions.claim: Adding it to foods and health foods is illegal: strict punishment on sampling inspection, transfer to police if criminal — but this happens only after you have eaten it — conveyed in RU.
assertions.cn_span: 往食品和保健食品里加它是违法的，抽检查到就严处，涉嫌犯罪的移送公安

assertions.claim: Sibutramine and phenolphthalein are both banned as food additives (incl. health foods) — conveyed in RU.
assertions.cn_span: 西布曲明与酚酞均禁止添加于食品（含保健食品）

assertions.claim: Phenolphthalein: long-term excessive use can cause electrolyte imbalance and induce arrhythmia; RU states the electrolyte effect directly and hedges arrhythmia with 'в тяжёлых случаях' — hedging nuance, warning direction unchanged.
assertions.cn_span: 长期过量可造成电解质紊乱、诱发心律失常

assertions.claim: SCOUT did not prove the same harm in healthy young people, yet the regulator withdrew the drug because the at-risk population cannot be identified — logic preserved in RU.
assertions.cn_span: 试验没有证明健康年轻人吃它同样出事；但正因为风险人群识别不了，监管才直接撤市
